property_summary: After a successful withdrawReward(recipient), rewardsForA[recipient] is zeroed, so a second withdrawReward to the same codeless recipient succeeds and pays out nothing (contract balance unchanged); the mutant never clears the reward and pays 100 wei again, shrinking the balance.
change_summary: Replace `rewardsForA[recipient] = 0;` with `rewardsForA[recipient] = amountToWithdraw;` so the balance is not cleared.
